ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (28) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

Attributions follow the print: «Род» (Rod) and «Гардюен» (Gardyuen, 'Harduin', as elsewhere in the book), not expanded; in the body «Жозеф Местр» (Zhozef Mestr) is given the established form Joseph de Maistre and «г-н Мольтке» (g-n Mol'tke) is 'Mr. Moltke'. The de Maistre sentence announced in section 2 is printed after the Harduin attribution, outside the quotation, and is kept there as printed.

Source observation: [19] The de Maistre quotation announced at the end of [11] (“Joseph de Maistre extolled… thus:”) is printed after the Harduin attribution [18], outside the blockquote, as a separate paragraph; probably a displaced footnote. Translated in place as printed.
